# LoansFlow

> LoansFlow (https://loansflow.loan) is an independent, educational site with plain-English guides and free calculators for SBA business loans (7(a), 504, Express, Microloan), lines of credit, term loans, equipment financing and mortgages. It is not a lender and does not make credit decisions. Written by Joshua Miller, CPA.

Facts on this site carry an "as of" date and a link to the primary source (SBA.gov, FRED, Freddie Mac, CFPB). Figures are estimates for planning, not offers.

## Loan types
- [SBA 7(a) loan](https://loansflow.loan/loans/sba-7a.html): requirements, maximum rates, fees, $350,000 worked example
- [SBA 504 loan](https://loansflow.loan/loans/sba-504.html)
- [SBA Express](https://loansflow.loan/loans/sba-express.html)
- [SBA Microloan](https://loansflow.loan/loans/sba-microloan.html)
- [Line of credit](https://loansflow.loan/loans/line-of-credit.html)
- [Commercial term loan](https://loansflow.loan/loans/commercial-term-loan.html)
- [Equipment financing](https://loansflow.loan/loans/equipment-financing.html)
- [Mortgage](https://loansflow.loan/loans/mortgage.html)
